name: Nils, Discipline Enforcer
oracle_text:
At the beginning of your end step, for each player, put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature that player controls.
Each creature with one or more counters on it can't attack you or planeswalkers you control unless its controller pays {X}, where X is the number of counters on that creature.
blocked_sentences: Each creature with one or more counters on it can't attack you or planeswalkers you control unless its controller pays {X}, where X is the number of counters on that creature.

needs.what: an attack_tax whose generic price is a value read off each attacking creature at declaration -- here {X} where X is the total number of counters (of any kind) on that creature -- so a creature with three counters pays {3} to attack you or a planeswalker you control
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The attack_tax static (affects: {has_counters: true}, or_planeswalkers: true) takes a 'cost' that the loader requires to be a fixed mana string, and player_statics.attack_tax sums those strings via _summed_mana with no access to the attacker; there is no static_value_keys hook (counters_on bound to the attacking creature) that could size the tax per creature. A fixed {1} or {2} would be a different card, and cant_attack would be a lock rather than a tax.
